visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at night in an urban plaza. A man with glasses, wearing a brown hoodie, holds a young boy in a beige sweater. Behind them is a large truck carrying a full-scale Formula 1 car constructed entirely from black and teal Lego bricks. Bright artificial lights illuminate the scene. (2) The young boy runs and dances playfully on a gray stone-tiled floor in front of the Lego truck. Bright neon lights from surrounding buildings are visible in the background. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor retail store with bright, warm lighting and a yellow floor. A long display table holds several small Lego F1 car models in various colors (red, green, blue). A staff member in a black polo shirt stands nearby. (4) The boy stands at the table, reaching out to touch the red Lego cars. The man leans in, pointing at the models and smiling. (5) Close-up shots show the man's hands handling a blue Red Bull Lego F1 car and a black Haas Lego F1 car. The intricate details of the plastic bricks and decals are visible. (6) The man and boy walk through the store aisles, which are filled with yellow shelves stocked with Lego boxes. The man makes a 'money' gesture with his fingers. (7) A display case shows a detailed diorama of an F1 pit lane with many Lego figures and cars. (8) Transition to a dimly lit room at night. The man sits at a desk, looking intently at a laptop screen and typing. (9) In a well-lit living room, the man sits on a gray sofa and opens a brown cardboard shipping box. Two young boys sit next to him, their faces lighting up with excitement as they see the Lego boxes inside. (10) The boys hug the Lego boxes (one red Ferrari, one black car) and lean against the man, who smiles and gives a thumbs up to the camera. The boys lift the boxes over their heads in celebration.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 father, 2 sons, 1 Lego staff member, approximately 4 passers-by in the background of the mall and store.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The father is a male in his 30s with short black hair and glasses, wearing a brown hoodie. The two sons are young boys; one wears a beige sweater and the other a navy long-sleeve shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An outdoor city plaza at night with large event displays and modern buildings; a bright yellow-themed Lego retail store with shelves of products; a typical domestic living room with a gray sofa.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track featuring a driving synthetic beat. A male voice speaks with high energy and bright intonation. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect occurs during a visual transition. Background chatter from a public space is audible at a low level. (3) A 'ching-ching' coin-like sound effect plays when discussing the price in the store. The male voice adopts a slightly more rhythmic, melodic delivery. (4) The audio shifts to a quieter setting where the clicking of a laptop keyboard and mouse is heard underneath the music. The voice drops in volume to a low conversational level. (5) In the final segment, high-pitched vocalizations and laughter from children dominate the foreground, accompanied by the rustling sound of cardboard being handled. The music swells slightly to a triumphant finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience -> Decision -> Action -> Reward
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family outing to a Lego F1 exhibition and store, leading to the father purchasing Lego sets for his children and their joyful reaction upon receiving the items at home. It serves as a lifestyle vlog that promotes Lego products and the shared experience of hobby collecting.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear and frequent display of LEGO branding, specific product sets, and the momo shopping platform logo on the shipping box.
